summary: AvalonBay Communities filed an 8-K disclosing litigation updates related to its pending all-stock merger of equals with Equity Residential, forming Vivmark Residential. Demand letters and three shareholder complaints allege disclosure deficiencies in the definitive joint proxy statement. The merger was previously announced and the registration statement declared effective July 13, 2026. The filing notes AvlonBay and Equity believe the allegations lack merit, but outcomes are unpredictable.
